stage: exploratory conditional price-proxy screen on previously inspected history
decision: Describe whether delayed gap changes warrant further data work. No Sharpe, annualized strategy return, significance claim, forecast, or deployment verdict.
limitations: Current hourly close gap is a price proxy, not a synchronized executable signal.
Signal candle starting s is known at s+1h; delayed entry candle starts s+1h and ends s+2h; exit starts s+25h.
Classifications and nonoverlap flags are frozen before checking any outcomes.
Observed endpoint changes do not establish a complete held-position path.
Cash/fee/funding/spread hurdles are reference scenarios, not realized historical costs.
Current contract metadata does not establish historical account tradability or margin.
The date and broad historical distribution were already seen; this is not preregistered independent evidence.
